notes: CurseForge is now a second source in Discover alongside Modrinth: mods, resource packs and shaders can install from CurseForge too (modpacks stay Modrinth-only). CurseForge search needs a free API key that is stored only on this device. Mods now install only to Fabric profiles, so Vanilla profiles are protected in the UI and in the backend. Windows and Linux builds are available.
